websiteSource.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Alberta.
websiteSource.method: Exact normalized school name AND address1, with exact normalized authority name as an extra check. Normalization: case and diacritics, punctuation/whitespace; address-only common street-type/direction abbreviations and numeric ordinal suffixes. No school-name words removed; no fuzzy match, address-only match, name-only match or guessed URLs. Require exactly one provincial candidate and an http(s) School Website. Source URLs retained without rewriting.
websiteSource.limitations: The provincial directory identifies the published school website but individual destinations have not all been opened. Does not establish attendance boundaries, current grade-specific program availability, admission eligibility, or operating status. Unmatched and ambiguous cases get no website.

qualityNotes.name: Chinook Learning Services
qualityNotes.note: The City publishes a southwest address with a map point in Tuxedo Park. Confirm the current campus before using this distance.
qualityNotes.treatment: Source point, address and area membership retained unchanged; display the discrepancy beside the distance.

method.levels: The source elem, junior_h and senior_h flags establish the three groups. Multi-level schools appear in every reported group. GRADES is preserved as the supplied group description, not interpreted as a numbered grade range. Unknown levels remain available in a separate filter. School names are never used to guess grade levels.
method.records: All source points retained, with distinct institutions at a shared campus kept separate. Post-secondary institutions are excluded from the elementary/junior-high/high-school directory.
method.areaMembership: Source points tested against the bundled community and quadrant polygons using containsPoint. All matched area codes are retained; a single community/quadrant is assigned only when unambiguous. Geographic inclusion does not establish a school catchment.
method.distances: Great-circle straight-line distance from the selected property or labelled representative area point. Not walking/driving distance, travel time, designated school or admission eligibility.
method.websites: No individual website field is present in the City school schema. When the reviewed Alberta directory join is supplied, require exact normalized name, address and authority; preserve its provenance separately. Invalid or multi-URL values remain null, as do unmatched records. Links are source-published, not individually uptime-verified.

limitations: Coverage is the published City registry, not a guarantee that every currently operating institution or program is listed.
The publisher excludes private Early Childhood Services operators. Post-secondary sites are retained only for source reconciliation, not shown in the school list.
School grades, operators, addresses and admission rules can change. Confirm with the school or authority.
Distances and area membership use the published school map point. Source locations can lag a move or differ from the supplied address; reviewed discrepancies are shown on individual records.
Listed points can include online or specialized program offices; a mapped record is not proof of an in-person teaching campus.
No school rankings, enrolment capacity, attendance-boundary polygons or guaranteed placement are supplied.
City quadrant polygons have their own dated footprint; school address quadrants and geographic quadrant membership can differ.
